_note: Template only — farmhand auto-installs agent on boot via bundleInstallPlugin. For manual install: refarm agent install. Entry and integrity are injected at install time.
name: Agent

respond.doc: Delegate a prompt to a sub-agent: it runs a full autonomous turn (its own model + tools, in its own instance and session) and returns the final response. Use this to hand a self-contained task to a fresh agent without polluting the current conversation. Returns the sub-agent's content plus token/usage.

prompt.description: The task/instruction for the sub-agent to carry out.

system.description: Optional system prompt overriding the sub-agent's default persona.

session_id.description: Optional session id to continue an existing sub-agent conversation instead of starting fresh.

history_turns.description: Optional cap on how many prior turns of the referenced session to include.

provider.description: Optional model provider override for the sub-agent turn.

model.description: Optional model override for the sub-agent turn.
